title: Phase-Field Approximation of Vectorial Cohesive Models
summary: We study the $Γ$-convergence of a general class of anisotropic phase-field functionals modelling cohesive fracture in the multidimensional, vector-valued, and geometrically nonlinear setting. The limiting energy comprises a quasiconvexified bulk term, a Cantor part governed by its recession function, and a cohesive surface energy density defined via an asymptotic cell problem.
